scripts.pool:start: npm run pool:build && sh -c 'if [ -f pool/.env ]; then exec node --env-file=pool/.env pool/src/server.js; else exec node pool/src/server.js; fi'
scripts.pool:dev: npm run pool:build && sh -c 'if [ -f pool/.env ]; then exec node --env-file=pool/.env --watch pool/src/server.js; else exec node --watch pool/src/server.js; fi'
scripts.start: kill $(lsof -tiTCP:3000 -sTCP:LISTEN) 2>/dev/null || true; npm run build && node --env-file=.env src/server.js
scripts.dev: kill $(lsof -tiTCP:3000 -sTCP:LISTEN) 2>/dev/null || true; npm run build && node --env-file=.env --watch src/server.js
